title.narrative: Apoyo, protección y fortalecimiento de activistas y organizaciones de la sociedad civil en su labor de promoción de los derechos humanos (APROFORT)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to provide support, protection and capacity building for civil society activists and organizations working in the field of human rights promotion and good governance. The strengthening and support of civil society will guarantee the achievement of the general objectives of abolition of the death penalty and the promotion of human rights through the fulfilment of international commitments by the government.
